tasks.short: Help applicants complete forms for referrals or unemployment claims.

steps.what: Provide applicants with assistance completing application forms
Check unemployment compensation claims for blank fields
Confirm job referral forms with the applicant
Sign the form as ready to lodge
Lodge the signed application form
outputs: filed copy of signed application form v1

tasks.design: The interviewer helps the applicant complete the form in {GOV_PORTAL}. A job checks unemployment compensation claims and referral forms for blank required fields and does not fill answers. The interviewer confirms the form, signs it as ready, and a job lodges that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Blank fields were found after the form had already been lodged.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields can be checked before lodgement.
tasks.still_hard: The answers still come from the applicant, with the interviewer's help.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides the form is ready to lodge.
tasks.altitude: Helping the applicant stays. The blank-field check and lodging the signed form shrink.

reach.task: Correct a blank the interviewer shows them
reach.learn: That the check is not a decision

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
The clerk digest says benefit computations are plain code, while eligibility judgement stays with a person.

assumptions: The job does not invent an answer.
unknowns: Which form version is in force.
Whether the applicant must sign as well.
research_questions: How often a required field is not on the form in front of them.

already_counted.description: Helping complete the form stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare applications for school, employment, or medical services.

steps.what: Prepare applications and forms for applicants
Check school enrollment, employment, and medical services fields
Confirm the purposes of each application
Sign the prepared application set
File the signed application set
outputs: filed copy of signed application set v1

tasks.design: The interviewer prepares the applications and forms with the applicant in {DOCS}. A job checks fields for school enrollment, employment, and medical services. The interviewer confirms the purposes, signs the set, and a job files that version. The job does not submit it to a school or a clinic.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right form was easy to miss when several purposes were in one visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Field lists for those forms can be checked without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Which purpose this visit is for still has to be heard.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides the set is the right one.
tasks.altitude: Preparing the forms stays. Checking fields and filing the signed set shrink.

reach.task: Take the signed set to the place that needs it

evidence.claim: The clerk digest says benefit computations are plain code, while eligibility judgement stays with a person.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.

assumptions: The job does not send the set to a school or a clinic.
unknowns: Which forms this office is allowed to prepare.
Whether medical information may be copied.
research_questions: How often the official form has changed.

already_counted.description: Preparing the applications stays inside the remaining time of that step.

tasks.short: Investigate claimants for the possibility of fraud or abuse.

steps.what: Investigate claimants for the possibility of fraud
List documents already stored on the case
Judge whether the file shows abuse
Sign the fraud investigation note
File the signed investigation note
outputs: filed copy of signed fraud investigation v1

tasks.design: The interviewer investigates the possibility of fraud or abuse. A job lists documents already on the case in {GOV_PORTAL} and does not flag or score the person. The interviewer judges, signs the note, and a job files that note. No risk model is built.
tasks.previous_blocker: A fraud model elsewhere flagged more people and was no better than caseworkers, and a risk system was struck down for lack of transparency.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file can list the documents it already holds.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the file shows fraud or abuse is an investigation, not a calculation.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer judges the possibility and is responsible for the note.
tasks.altitude: The investigation does not shrink. Listing documents and filing the signed note do.

reach.task: Read the signed note before any further step
reach.learn: That the document list is not a flag

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] records that a welfare-fraud model flagged more people, was no better than caseworkers, and was stopped, so no such model is built and the person decides.
Digest [S22] records that a court struck down a benefits-fraud risk system as insufficiently transparent, so this design does not score claimants.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.

assumptions: No score, rank, or flag of a person is produced.
The document list is an index, not a risk.
unknowns: Who may open a fraud investigation.
What standard the note must meet.
research_questions: How often the case file is missing the document that matters.

already_counted.description: The investigation stays inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Conduct housing reviews and home visits against the regulations.

steps.what: Conduct annual, interim, and special housing reviews
Make the home visits the review requires
Ensure conformance to the housing regulations
Sign the housing review
File the signed housing review
outputs: filed copy of signed housing review v1

tasks.design: Annual, interim, and special housing reviews, and the home visits, stay in person. The interviewer ensures conformance to the regulations, signs the review, and a job files that note in {GOV_PORTAL}. No camera or remote check replaces the visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Visit notes were written up later and could miss the regulation they were checking.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed when the interviewer returns.
tasks.still_hard: Conformance is what the interviewer sees on the visit.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides whether the housing conforms.
tasks.altitude: The review and the visit do not shrink. Filing the signed note does.

evidence.claim: Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S21] says call recording and staff dashboards need works-council consent, so interviews are not recorded into a dashboard.

assumptions: No remote watch of the home is added.
unknowns: Which regulations apply to this housing.
Who must be present for the visit.
research_questions: How often a visit cannot be completed.

already_counted.description: The review and the home visit stay inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

role.altitude: The eligibility interviewer spends the week on the interview and the decision. Completeness checks and filing a signed note move to a job. No model decides a benefit or scores a person.
reach: Applicants hear the decision from the interviewer, not from a generated refusal.
Social workers receive only the extract the interviewer signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a published table amount from the decision to authorize it.
Refuse any list that ranks or flags people.
role.ambitious_version: A signed decision can open the payment instruction, and the interviewer still authorizes that amount.
